obligations.source_text: Create one independent, complex photographic test of the assigned aeolian dune wind structure keyword, use the attached portrait only as an adult appearance reference, and make the environmental structure primary enough for strict pixel review.

bindings.dune_stoss_phrase: a broad gently rising windward stoss slope forms one side of the dune
bindings.dune_crest_phrase: a narrow continuous crest separates the gentle stoss side from the lee side in full oblique profile
bindings.dune_slipface_phrase: a visibly steeper smooth slip face descends immediately behind the crest
bindings.dune_transport_phrase: fine sand ripples or short saltation traces align coherently across the stoss surface
